inAppFreeROMs.description: Allows downloading free ROMs directly in the app. Disabled for App Store builds.

romPathMigrator.description: Enables the ROM path migration tool.

cheatsUseSwiftUI.description: Use SwiftUI for the cheats interface.

retroarchBuiltinEditor.description: Enables the built-in RetroArch editor. Disabled for App Store builds.

advancedSkinFeatures.description: Enables advanced skin features like filters and debug mode.

contentlessCores.description: Enables contentless cores like DOOM, Quake, etc.

cheatsOnlineLookup.description: Enables online lookup for cheat codes via GitHub API with 24h disk cache.

dynamicLibretroScanner.description: Scans Frameworks/ at startup for bare .libretro.framework dylibs and registers them as thin-wrapper cores (no RetroArch binary required). On tvOS: enabled by default. On iOS: disable by default but can be enabled in Settings > Advanced > Feature Flags.

pauseTileMenu.description: Experimental tile/grid based pause menu that floats over the game screen instead of the classic tab/list panel. Enable in Settings > Advanced > Feature Flags.

tapToRemapUI.description: Tap-to-remap UX in button remapping settings: press a physical controller button to select the remapping destination instead of choosing from a list. Disabled by default during development — enable in Settings > Advanced > Feature Flags.

mupenTransferPak.description: Enables Transfer Pak configuration UI for Mupen64Plus N64 cores. Allows mounting a GB/GBC ROM into a virtual Transfer Pak for games like Pokémon Stadium. Disabled by default — enable in Settings > Advanced > Feature Flags.

netplayEnabled.description: Enables native SwiftUI netplay UI for RetroArch cores (LAN room browser, host/join, in-game HUD). RetroArch already has HAVE_NETPLAY compiled in — this gates the native Provenance UI on top. Disabled by default during Phase 1-3 development.

modernWebServer.description: Replaces the vendored 2015 ObjC GCDWebServer with a Swift-native Hummingbird HTTP/WebDAV server via PVWebServerManager. Both implementations fire the same PVWebServer*Notification constants. Disabled by default during Epic #2758 stabilisation — enable in Settings > Advanced > Feature Flags.

clipBuffering.description: Always-on ReplayKit clip buffering. Keeps a rolling recording buffer so users can save recent gameplay clips at any time. Disabled until stable — enable in Settings > Advanced > Feature Flags.

liveBroadcast.description: ReplayKit Go Live broadcast button in the pause menu. Disabled until stable — enable in Settings > Advanced > Feature Flags.

lightGunCrosshair.description: Renders a configurable crosshair overlay at the cursor position during light-gun gameplay. Disabled by default — enable in Settings > Advanced > Feature Flags.

companionController.description: Companion Controller overlay — use this device as a secondary controller for systems with non-standard input peripherals (trackball, numpad, Atari 5200). Disabled until DSU integration is complete — enable in Settings > Advanced > Feature Flags.

smartCoreSelection.description: Enriched core selection UI with capability badges, quality rankings, and per-game recommendations when multiple cores are available. Disabled until core capability data is fully audited — enable in Settings > Advanced > Feature Flags.

skinButtonReposition.description: Drag-to-reposition button layout editor for custom skins. iOS only (DragGesture unavailable on tvOS). Disabled by default — enable in Settings > Advanced > Feature Flags.

enhancedArtworkSearch.description: Multi-source artwork matching at ROM import time (TheGamesDB, LibretroDB, OpenVGDB). Background ArtworkSearchQueue retries unmatched games. Enabled by default — disable in Settings > Advanced > Feature Flags if regressions are found.
